intent: Repaint the sixteen new guardian placeholders and replace inventory icons whose small silhouettes obscure their meaning.
boss_reference: Each original game/assets/foes/<id>.png is the identity reference; game/assets/foes/kiln-warden.png is the finished linework and shading reference. Full transparent subject, facing screen left toward the player.
icon_reference: game/assets/shardrun/card-fire-constant.png supplies bronze, jewel, and chunky pixel-art material. Each new object has one bold silhouette designed for 32 px display and a transparent background.

icons.relic-dry-principle: two duplicate scrolls gathered by one clasp, replacing a spoon-like silhouette
icons.relic-dependency-bundle: three scrolls tied into a bundle, replacing a vial-like silhouette
icons.relic-hello-world: first message from a small terminal, replacing a generic orb
icons.shard-priority-queue: three ranked crystal tokens, replacing a brush-like silhouette
icons.shard-cross-product: two crystal axes crossing, replacing a framed eye-like silhouette
icons.shard-ramp: three rising steps, replacing a rock-like silhouette
icons.shard-census: stone tablet with large tally cuts, replacing a crate-like silhouette
icons.shard-pair-fold: two leaves folding around a shared hinge, replacing a single tile
icons.shard-prefix-charge: three crystal cells accumulating charge, replacing a dense board
